context: Interactive 3D tech demo: 1500 named colors plotted in OKLCH color space, orbitable with WebGL, filterable by lightness and chroma slice planes
first_impression: A polished dark-themed color space explorer where the color cloud itself is visually striking against the deep navy background, with clean glassmorphism UI controls that stay out of the way.
what_works: The dark navy background (#1a1a2e) is a deliberate and effective choice — it lets the color points read as data without competition, and the self-colored dots make the OKLCH structure immediately legible. The control panel and count badge share a consistent semi-transparent glass style with matching borders and type treatment, showing real design coherence.
what_doesnt: The color cloud occupies roughly the center-right of the viewport with a large empty lower third — the camera starting angle doesn't frame the cloud well, making the composition feel unbalanced at rest. The axis label ('X: Hue · Y: Lightness · Z: Chroma') at 12px and 50% opacity is so quiet it barely registers, and without visible 3D axis lines or tick marks, spatial orientation while orbiting relies entirely on memory.
